summary: This research study is testing a drug called NNC0487-0111 to see how well it helps people with excess body weight lose weight. Participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine, given as a weekly injection under the skin. The study is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S and is currently Recruiting. There are 1150 participants taking part in this Phase 3 study.
